chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم used to place the spear before him when he performed salat (prayer).

key_terms.الْعَنَزَةَ: a short spear or staff placed in front of the worshipper

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم place in front of him during salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم would place an 'anazah before himself during salat (prayer). It indicates a prophetic practice related to what is set in front of the worshipper while praying.
